description:
Telekom HBS, part of the Telekom Group, is an ICT Systems Integrator offering a comprehensive suite of ICT Solutions and Services.

Telekom HBS, specializes in delivering ICT Services in areas such as Cloud, Data Centre operations, Networking, Cybersecurity, BI and Data Warehouse, Big Data, Service Desk, Proactive Monitoring, Operations and Support, Service Management, Project and Programme Management, and Professional Services. We are seeking an Senior DevOps Engineer to join our team and be responsible for the following tasks:

  • Architect new services using the latest technologies
  • Designing and implementation of the infrastructure for new projects
  • Integration with third-party APIs
  • Deploy new services in AWS
  • CI/CD design and implementation
  • Monitoring and Performance Optimization
  • Container Orchestration and Kubernetes Management

Minimum Requirements:

  • Minimum 8 years of DevOps Experience
  • 8+ years of combined experience in development and systems administration.
  • Experience creating and managing Docker containers and Kubernetes clusters for production workloads
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment strategies across multiple environments
  • Solid Infrastructure knowledge (especially Linux/Docker/AWS/Azure/Kubernetes) with hands-on cloud experience
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code tools (Terraform, CloudFormation) and monitoring systems (Prometheus, Grafana)
  • Development knowledge in a widely used development language (Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Java)
  • Be able to grasp new concepts and technologies quickly, and implement projects using the latest technologies

 

Required Soft Skills:

  • Teamwork: Develops and promotes effective relationships with colleagues and team members. Deals constructively with conflicts.
  • Communicating: Expresses oneself clearly in conversations and interactions with others; listens actively. Produces effective written communications. Ensures that information is shared.
  • Respecting and promoting individual and cultural differences: Demonstrates the ability to work constructively with people of all backgrounds and orientations. Respects differences and ensures that all can contribute.
  • Knowing and managing yourself: Manages ambiguity and pressure in a self-reflective way. Uses criticism as a development opportunity. Seeks opportunities for continuous learning and professional growth.
  • Producing results: Produces and delivers quality results. Is action oriented and committed to achieving outcomes.
  • Moving forward in a changing environment: Is open to and proposes new approaches and ideas. Adapts and responds positively to change. 

 

Desirable Requirements:

  • Good written and verbal communication skills, interpersonal and collaborative skills
  • Ability to work in a team that is geographically dispersed and with teammates of different cultures
  • A high degree of initiative, being independent and able to work with little supervision
  • Be able to work in multiple projects at the same time
  • A high level of personal integrity, as well as the ability to professionally handle confidential matters, and show an appropriate level of judgement and maturity
  • Ability to deliver quality results
  • Experience with Project Management methodologies (PRINCE2/PMP, SCRUM, Agile methodology)
  • Excellent technical documentation skills, and ability to deliver technical trainings
  • Customer-centric approach to delivery and problem-solving skills
  • AI/ML knowledge is a plus
  • DevOps, JIRA and GitHub experience is a plus
  • Special Interest with DevOps/Infrastructure related tasks
  • Strong English communication skills
  • Basic knowledge of other recognized UN languages is desirable

 

Desirable Certifications:

  • Any Azure or AWS certifications linked to Infrastructure, Development or Data management is a plus
  • Master’s university degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology is a plus
